conversions.description: ClickConversion objects with conversionAction, conversionDateTime (including timezone), and click ids or userIdentifiers. Optional fields include conversionValue, currencyCode, orderId, and consent. Google permits each orderId once per conversion action; inspect partialFailureError for rejected entries.

customerId.description: The 10-digit Google Ads account id to query, e.g. 1234567890 (dashes allowed). Under a manager account this is the client account, not the manager.

loginCustomerId.description: Manager (MCC) account id, sent as the login-customer-id header. Required when the account is accessed through a manager account.

validateOnly.description: Validate the batch and return errors without recording anything.
